name: Corruption Perceptions Index
methodology_note:
Score (post-2012 scale) is comparable across years; rank is not, as country coverage changes. Ranks known from reports: 2024: 96th of 180; 2025: 91st of 182 (score 39). Scores 2013-2024 per Our World in Data's TI series (https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/ti-corruption-perception-index); 2025 per press coverage (Catholic Connect, Drishti IAS). Per-point links go to TI's edition pages. No specific government rebuttal located.

Back-fill (pre-2014 editions, researched by deepseek, unreviewed): Score (post-2012 scale) is comparable across years; rank is not, as country coverage changes. Ranks known from reports: 2024: 96th of 180; 2025: 91st of 182 (score 39). Scores 2013-2024 per Our World in Data's TI series (https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/ti-corruption-perception-index); 2025 per press coverage (Catholic Connect, Drishti IAS). Per-point links go to TI's edition pages. No specific government rebuttal located. Pre-2012 points (2004-2011) are TI's original 0-10 CPI scores (higher = cleaner) and are stored with out_of 10; they are not directly comparable with the post-2012 0-100 scores. TI changed the CPI scale and methodology in 2012 (0-100 scale; revised aggregation), so 2012 (36) is the first point on the current scale. The 2004-2011 values come from TI's official per-edition data CSV files (linked from each edition page); 2012 is from TI's 2012 results. Ranks in the pre-2012 editions: 2004 90th, 2005 88th, 2006 70th, 2007 72nd, 2008 85th, 2009 84th, 2010 91st, 2011 95th.
